scope: 104 currently purchasable SEGA AppIDs plus retired FM26 and 2 historical standalone titles; 107 historical game identities. Not all SEGA games ever published.
edition_policy: User permits complete base-game edition continuity by AppID. Historical standalone titles exit scope at observed collection-only price transition; unrelated games are not merged.
inference: Final price exports lack official list-price and package identity fields. Historical baselines and brief anomaly corrections are explicit reviewed inferences, not claimed official historical discounts. Original bytes and SHA-256 are preserved.
zero_rule: Zero/blank unknown unless independent delisting evidence supports denominator exclusion; no extension beyond final source time.
one_cent_policy: User explicitly instructed that a one-cent difference below reviewed full price means no promotion, regardless of duration. Original prices are retained. Brief high-price spikes require identical baseline immediately before/after and explicit audit overrides.
